integrity: Integer presentations were obtained by explicit unit substitutions; the infinite Smith result is cited from original scientific literature. Finite replay is corroboration, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary A4 row-orbit homology for n>=7 and simple connectivity are proved. Cohomology products, homotopy wedge decomposition, and other symmetry groups are not classified; no external independent audit is claimed.
title: Unbounded three-primary torsion in alternating-row quotients of four-row chessboard complexes
